_about: Reusable data caveats for the insolvency data hub. Pages reference caveats by id rather than re-wording them, so the disclaimers stay consistent and the methodology page can own the canonical text. British English. ASCII only.

caveats.latest_provisional: The latest monthly figures are provisional and are routinely revised when later releases are published.
caveats.sa_vs_nsa: Seasonally adjusted and non-seasonally adjusted figures are not directly comparable and should not be mixed.
caveats.nations_sa_difference: Scotland and Northern Ireland figures are not seasonally adjusted in the same way as England and Wales, so cross-nation comparisons should be made with care.
caveats.sector_lag: Industry and sector data is published one month behind the headline figures.
caveats.sic_self_reported: Industry is based on self-reported SIC codes, which can be inaccurate or out of date.
caveats.registered_office: A company's registered office may not be where it actually traded, so regional figures are an approximation.
caveats.sector_volumes_not_rates: These are volumes, not sector failure rates. Larger sectors hold more companies and so tend to record more insolvencies.
caveats.gazette_not_outcome: Gazette notices are legal notices, not completed insolvency procedures. A petition may be dismissed, withdrawn or settled before any order is made.
caveats.dissolutions_not_insolvencies: Dissolutions and strike-offs are ordinary company closures, not insolvencies, and must not be added to insolvency totals.
caveats.ons_denominator: ONS business counts are a useful denominator but are not a perfect census of every small or unregistered business.
caveats.payment_practices_enrichment: Payment practices data is late-payment context only. It is not an insolvency statistic and must never be blended into, or presented as, insolvency figures.
caveats.payment_self_reported: Payment performance figures are self-reported by large businesses under a statutory duty and are not independently audited, so individual reports can be inconsistent or contain data-entry errors.
caveats.payment_large_companies_only: Only large UK companies and LLPs that meet the reporting thresholds must report, so these figures describe big-business payment behaviour, not the whole economy.
